name: The Arctic Fox
source:
It follows three Arctic researchers on their way to Research Station Wolfram. Suddenly, they are kidnapped by a powerful being. They wake up near the facility, but many things are not as they used to be. Will they all make it back alive?

[From [url=https://parrexion-games.itch.io/the-arctic-fox]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
影片讲述了三名北极研究人员前往沃尔夫勒姆研究站的途中。突然，他们被一个强大的存在绑架了。他们在设施附近醒来，但很多事情都不像以前那样了。他们都能活着回来吗？

[来自[url=https://parrexion-games.itch.io/the-arctic-fox]Itch.io[/url]]
